about: Advisories the dependency audit allows. scripts/ops/audit-dependencies.mjs fails on any advisory not listed here, on an exception past its reviewBy date, on an exception for a package installed for production, and on an exception npm audit no longer reports.

exceptions.reason: Published 2026-10-30; fixed only in minimatch 11.0.1. Every installed copy is development tooling: eslint 9, @eslint/eslintrc, @eslint/config-array and three eslint plugins need minimatch 3, which exports a function that 11 does not; @typescript-eslint and @ts-morph/common use 10.2. No 3.x or 10.x release carries the fix. The flaw is in the **/.. pattern optimization, which our own lint and knip configuration controls. Recheck for eslint and plugin releases that accept minimatch 11.

Low severity, published 2026-09-18, no fixed release of deepmerge exists. Installed only through the shadcn component CLI (a development dependency) and its registry package, which merge local configuration files we write. Recheck for a deepmerge release or a shadcn release that drops it.
